title: CAD-Glaucoma
subtitle: Computer-Aided Detection System for Glaucoma Diagnosis
desc: A web-based medical analytics platform using a U-Net model trained on Indonesian clinical data to segment the optic disc and cup, compute Cup-to-Disc Ratios (CDR), and enable doctor-in-the-loop polygon annotations.

title: Palm Oil Fruit Counting
subtitle: Precision Agriculture Analytics
desc: An end-to-end AI annotation and counting server built with X-AnyLabeling and SAM-3 for precise agricultural metrics.

title: SessionIntent
subtitle: Linux Workspace Session Manager
desc: A Linux-centric productivity tool that automatically initializes specific application sets across multiple desktop workspaces.

title: Ingatini
subtitle: AI-Powered Document Chatbot
desc: An AI chatbot that ingests documents and provides accurate responses using LangChain, Pgvector, and FastAPI for seamless information retrieval.

title: MilleRace
subtitle: Media & Information Literacy Relay Race Web Game
desc: An immersive, gamified Media and Information Literacy (MIL) relay race web game built for the UNESCO Youth Hackathon 2026.

title: WheelDeck
subtitle: Phone-as-Steering-Wheel for PC Racing Simulators
desc: Turn an Android or iOS phone into a steering wheel and dashboard control panel for PC racing and trucking simulators. A desktop companion app translates the phone's gyroscope steering, touch pedals, and buttons into a virtual game controller the simulator reads natively — no game plugins needed. Runs on Linux and Windows desktops; macOS planned.

title: NumericalMethods
subtitle: Numerical Methods Course Implementations
desc: A special repository for the Numerical Methods course from my uni, with all code written in C++ covering five methods including Gaussian elimination, Jacobi iteration, and Newton-Raphson.

title: PlayStation Game Store
subtitle: Native HTML/CSS/JS Game Store Website
desc: A native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript PlayStation game store website built for the Web Programming 2022 course in Informatics UNMUL. Feel free to use it as your CS project — see the license section on the README.

title: ROICropper
subtitle: Region-of-Interest Image Cropping Tool
desc: A Python utility to crop an image's object / region of interest from a single file or a whole folder.

title: GBatchCropper
subtitle: Gading's Batch Cropper
desc: A personal Python batch-cropping utility (v1.0-alpha) that crops images in bulk from predefined region coordinates.

title: HidupSehat
subtitle: All-in-one Healthy Lifestyle App
desc: An all-in-one application that can help describing and providing a comprehensive healthy living by focusing on healthy lifestyle concerns such as regulating food habits, drinking lots of water, managing mental health and stress, exercising frequently, and getting enough rest. Users can easily accomplish this with the assistance of Artificial Intelligence.
